title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing | TechCrunch
summary: On Monday, the startup introduced Cursor Start, a ₹649-a-month (about $7) subscription built specifically for India — and priced well below Cursor’s standard $20-a-month Pro subscription . Cursor is not alone in tailoring its pricing for India.
